name: research: explore a clinical table, group it, chart it, write it up
description: Tier 3, live Galaxy. A researcher's working session rather than a single request: look at the data, ask for a grouped comparison, chart it, then have the finding written into the record. Grouping1 carries a repeat, so the turn that runs it exercises the input-template path that previously produced an empty one. The chart turn names vintent: this scenario grades the session, not whether a charting request routes there, which is measured separately.
inputs: I have a clinical table in this history. What columns does it have, and how many rows?
Column 10 is Outcome, 1 means diabetic. Group the rows by Outcome and give me the mean of Glucose (column 3) and mean of BMI (column 7) for each group.
Chart that comparison with vintent as a bar chart.
Write what we found into the record page, including the actual numbers.
